coverage_notes: Frozen corpus membership is captures[].id plus captures[].sha256; all counts apply only to those 34 fixed Admin captures, before the parent standalone renderer-gallery expansion.
Captured means the described visual state is present in an inspected existing screenshot; it is not a passing interaction test.
Captured and DOM evidence were not synchronized; e.g. history-initial DOM is empty while its later screenshot is populated.

semantic-settled, semantic-retained and semantic-capabilities are byte-identical screenshots and DOM snapshots. Only the prepared form is evidenced; retained analysis and engine-capability results remain uncaptured.
context-selected and context-file show the same file-open scenario with different page/scroll capture positions.
All 34 Admin captures use the light theme. No 390px phone, 200% zoom, dark theme, real touch, screen reader, or full keyboard journey was verified.

needs_backend_integrations identifies behavior needing a live/configured backend or deliberate fixture fault/state injection for trustworthy observation; it does not claim every scenario requires an external vendor.
